notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
[b]Updates:[/b]
[list]
 [*]As requested by the players, camera controls have been introduced (use the arrow keys or the gamepad's right stick to look up or down) . 
 [*]The achievement localization bug has been fixed . 
 [*]Language preferences are now saved correctly . 
 [*]4k display compatibility issues have been fixed . 
[/list]
[b]News:[/b]
Jelly Killer has been released for the OUYA game console, as well as for Android and iOS devices. 
On mobile devices, you can check the game out for free!

[url=ouya.tv/game/Jelly-Killer][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12047410/b14046c23169dd5ba0713da95d8b51914b072d37.png[/img][/url]       
[url=itunes.apple.com/us/app/id1076281852][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12047410/d0706bd16e56c082e0ac9b26b848cf8534e1a435.png[/img][/url]
[url=play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ImmortalGameStudio.JellyKiller][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12047410/ecfc01b68ea6e4d76814f6bf438250a9670c9dc7.png[/img][/url]

[b]Have fun![/b]

notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
[h1][b]New difficulty level!!! Hard![/b][/h1]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[b]-[/b] Quick restart after death, press any key. 
[b]-[/b] Press “E”, “Enter” and “J” to grab or escape the body. 
[b]-[/b] Quick enter the game, press “Alt”+”F4”. 
[b]-[/b] Hitbox of lasers. Bug fixed. 
[b]-[/b] Fixed a bug of automatic shooting. 
[b]-[/b] The guard, seeing through the walls. Bug fixed. 
[b]-[/b] Fixed a bug of conveyor. 
[b]-[/b] Fixed a bug of menu item for widescreen monitors. 

[b]Have a nice game![/b]
